product_one_liner.value: Ethos is an AI-powered expert network for investment funds, consultancies, enterprises and AI labs that finds, screens, interviews and matches human experts to research, advisory and work opportunities.

pricing_page.notes: A public Ethos Evals pricing page lists usage-based pricing.

named_customers.notes: The recruiting product page labels these companies as hiring with Ethos.

employee_band.notes: The strongest contemporaneous report says the team had eight people, which does not fit any permitted band.

eng_blog.notes: The identifiable company blog material is launch/marketing content; no two qualifying engineering-build posts were found.

public_docs.notes: The public product homepage exposes no public documentation or developer-portal link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The AI Engineer posting is explicitly closed.

model_provider.notes: These providers are named on Ethos's public subprocessor list as AI/model-related processors.

compliance_certs.notes: The public materials refer to SOC 2 and ISO 27001 as certification work/audit examples, not as completed certifications; no completed claim among the five requested certifications was found.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series A was announced in May 2026, within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Account Executive opportunity is listed with an ASAP start and an application flow.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest identifiable launch-type company post is the March 23, 2026 platform/voice-agent launch material, before the six-month window beginning May 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available public team evidence identifies the founders but does not provide a sufficiently complete, dated C-level/VP join-or-departure record.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Each is named on the public subprocessor list for sales intelligence/lead generation or email discovery/verification.
